posts.title: April 2026 Update
posts.description: Been a while since I’ve posted anything here, but figured I’d at least mention that I’ve been with Mozilla for the past year or so, leading their New Products organization. We’re working on a lot of promising new stuff!

posts.title: Moving on from Betaworks Ventures
posts.description: This past Friday was my last day with Betaworks Ventures. It’s been just over six years since John Borthwick and Matt Hartman asked me to be the third partner in a new fund they were creating out of Betaworks, and saying yes to that was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made.
